name: Loudoun County
summary: The densest data center market in the world, with growing local debate over transmission lines, noise and land use.

name: Shelby County
summary: Memphis area. Home of xAI's Colossus, a widely cited example of community backlash over on-site gas turbines, emissions and noise.

name: Grant County
summary: Quincy area. Cheap hydropower drew early data centers; residents' early support has been tested by water use and noise.

name: Taylor County
summary: Abilene area. Most Texas counties have no zoning, which makes development faster and community input less formal.
